media.title: Hochzeitsreise zu Dritt (1932) — Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 524
media.description: Cover of Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 524, devoted to Hochzeitsreise zu Dritt (1932), a European-period film with music by Bronisław Kaper. This is a film-program/periodical cover, not a standard theatrical film poster; current local path is in the timeline images folder.
media.altText: Illustrated Film-Kurier cover for Hochzeitsreise zu Dritt, showing film-promotion artwork and issue text.
media.rightsNote: Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 524 (Berlin, 1932). Reviewed 2026-07-05: no individual cover designer credited. Anonymous German work, published 1932 → PD ~2003 (§66 UrhG, 70 yrs); underlying photo PD as Lichtbild (50 yrs); reproductions of PD 2-D works stay PD (EU DSM Art. 14). Rights upgraded fair-use → OK (public domain). Assumes no designer later identified; not legal advice. Credit: 'Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 524 (public domain)'.
